using UnityEngine;

namespace @NAMESPACE@
{
    public partial class @CLASS@
    {
@RESPONSE_CONSTANTS@

        // [Trailmap: 330-resistance] Project-neutral tuning; not a retail character's statistics.
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceLinearStat = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_NORMALIZED_STAT;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceQuadraticStat = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_NORMALIZED_STAT;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceSkidStat = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_NORMALIZED_STAT;
        [Range(0f, 1f)] public float resistanceLateralStat = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_NORMALIZED_STAT;
        public int resistanceMode = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_MODE;
        public int resistanceEdge = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_EDGE;
        public int resistancePreferredEdge = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_EDGE;
        public float resistanceLoadRatio = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_LOAD_RATIO;
        public float resistanceSkid = RESPONSE_DEFAULTS_SKID;

        float RideResponseStance()
        {
            if (resistanceEdge == resistancePreferredEdge || resistanceMode == 1) return 1f;
            return resistanceMode == 0 ? RESPONSE_STANCE_MODE0_MISMATCH : RESPONSE_STANCE_OTHER_MISMATCH;
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-resistance] Velocities, lengths and output acceleration use metres.
        float RideForwardResistance(int row, float u, float error, float budget, float charge, float boost)
        {
            float stance = RideResponseStance();
            float rA = (resistanceMode == 2
                ? RESPONSE_FORWARD_MODE2_LINEAR_BASE - RESPONSE_FORWARD_MODE2_LINEAR_STAT_SCALE * resistanceLinearStat
                : RESPONSE_FORWARD_LINEAR_BASE - RESPONSE_FORWARD_LINEAR_STAT_SCALE * resistanceLinearStat) * stance;
            float rC = (RESPONSE_FORWARD_QUADRATIC_BASE - RESPONSE_FORWARD_QUADRATIC_STAT_SCALE * resistanceQuadraticStat) * stance;
            float rS = (RESPONSE_FORWARD_SKID_BASE + RESPONSE_FORWARD_SKID_STAT_SCALE * resistanceSkidStat) * stance;
            float q = Mathf.Max(1f, resistanceLoadRatio);
            float x = Mathf.Abs(u) * RESPONSE_FORWARD_SPEED_SCALE;
            float depth = row == 3 || row == 4
                ? RESPONSE_FORWARD_POWDER_DEPTH_BASE - error / Mathf.Max(budget, RESPONSE_GUARDS_BUDGET_METRES) : 1f;
            return -u * depth * (q * _rideSurfResistanceA[row] * rA + (1f - charge) * RESPONSE_FORWARD_UNCHARGED_DRAG
                + (1f + boost * RESPONSE_FORWARD_BOOST_SKID_SCALE) * RESPONSE_FORWARD_SKID_DRAG * resistanceSkid * resistanceSkid * rS
                + x * (q * _rideSurfResistanceB[row] + x * q * _rideSurfResistanceC[row] * rC));
        }

        float RideLateralSpeedGain(float u)
        {
            float speed = Mathf.Abs(u);
            if (speed < RESPONSE_LATERAL_LOW_SPEED_MPS)
                return RESPONSE_LATERAL_LOW_BASE + speed * RESPONSE_LATERAL_LOW_SLOPE;
            if (speed < RESPONSE_LATERAL_MID_SPEED_MPS)
                return RESPONSE_LATERAL_MID_BASE + (speed - RESPONSE_LATERAL_LOW_SPEED_MPS) * RESPONSE_LATERAL_MID_SLOPE;
            return RESPONSE_LATERAL_HIGH_BASE - (speed - RESPONSE_LATERAL_MID_SPEED_MPS) * RESPONSE_LATERAL_HIGH_FALLOFF;
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-lateral] Acceleration; the ground integrator owns the single timestep multiplication.
        float RideLateralResistance(int row, float u, float w, float lean, float boost)
        {
            float rider = (RESPONSE_LATERAL_RIDER_BASE + RESPONSE_LATERAL_RIDER_STAT_SCALE * resistanceLateralStat)
                * RideResponseStance();
            float boostGain = boost > 0f ? 1f / (1f + RESPONSE_LATERAL_BOOST_SCALE * boost) : 1f;
            return -w * _rideSurfDrag[row] * RideLateralSpeedGain(u)
                * Mathf.Max(1f, Mathf.Abs(lean) * RESPONSE_LATERAL_LEAN_SCALE) * rider * boostGain;
        }

        float RideHeadingLead(float lean, float charge)
        {
            float shape = resistanceMode == 2 ? RESPONSE_LEAD_MODE2_SHAPE
                : resistanceMode == 0 ? RESPONSE_LEAD_MODE0_SHAPE : RESPONSE_LEAD_DEFAULT_SHAPE;
            float angleRad = resistanceMode == 2 ? RESPONSE_LEAD_MODE2_ANGLE_RAD
                : resistanceMode == 0 ? RESPONSE_LEAD_MODE0_ANGLE_RAD : RESPONSE_LEAD_DEFAULT_ANGLE_RAD;
            return lean * angleRad * (1f + RESPONSE_LEAD_SHAPE_SCALE * shape * (1f - lean * lean))
                / (1f + charge * RESPONSE_LEAD_CHARGE_SCALE);
        }

        // [Trailmap: 330-yaw] Radians per fixed tick, with full speed and signed contact projections in m/s.
        float RideHeadingYaw(float lean, float lead, float slipProjection, float speed,
            float forwardSpeed, float fallLineSpeed, float dt)
        {
            if (speed < RESPONSE_GUARDS_SPEED_MPS || dt <= 0f) return 0f;
            float candidate = lead - Mathf.Asin(Mathf.Clamp(slipProjection,
                -RESPONSE_YAW_SLIP_PROJECTION_LIMIT, RESPONSE_YAW_SLIP_PROJECTION_LIMIT));
            if (forwardSpeed < 0f) candidate = -candidate;
            float gate = Mathf.Min(1f, speed * speed * RESPONSE_YAW_SPEED_GATE * dt);
            float align = Mathf.Min(1f, Mathf.Max(0f, RESPONSE_YAW_ALIGN_SCALE * Mathf.Min(1f, speed / RESPONSE_YAW_ALIGN_SPEED_MPS)
                * (RESPONSE_YAW_ALIGN_RATIO - Mathf.Abs(fallLineSpeed) / speed)) + RESPONSE_YAW_ALIGN_BASE);
            float gain = Mathf.Max(candidate > 0f ? lean : -lean, align);
            return Mathf.Clamp(candidate * gate * gain, -RESPONSE_YAW_CAP_RAD_PER_TICK, RESPONSE_YAW_CAP_RAD_PER_TICK);
        }

        float RideBankedNormalResponse(float response, float cappedResponse, float theta)
        {
            return response + cappedResponse - cappedResponse / Mathf.Cos(theta);
        }
    }
